# Configuring

Intro mentioning nothing important.

## Configuration options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `host` | API host |
| `flushInterval` | Flush interval |
| `apiKey` | Public API key |
| `timeout` | Request timeout |

## Tracing headers

Set `tracingHeaders` to true to propagate W3C trace context:

```ts
createClient({ tracingHeaders: true })
```
